claims.claim_text: Engineering executive who turns regulated modernization and governed agentic AI architecture into an operating model for reliable, IP-led enterprise growth.
From that commercial base, governed agentic AI control-plane architecture gives platform decisions a clear leadership frame for scalable, accountable execution.

Against that lineage backdrop, release automation and security scanning were embedded in regulated modernization delivery paths, with deployment blueprints establishing repeatability alongside release-gate security coverage.
In parallel, human override and escalation paths, runtime proof bundles, and replayable audit manifests place control evidence inside platform operations.
Platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the team, linking architecture stewardship to measurable business value.
That foundation will keep platform productization anchored in governed architecture, evidence-based decisions, and disciplined team scale as enterprise AI priorities evolve.
